supporting_features.feature_phrase: abrupt lateral step between stacked sections
supporting_features.evidence: Successive printed sections change horizontal position instead of remaining vertically aligned.
The growing upper wall occupies one side of the lower footprint and leaves a recessed step on the opposite side.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: unequal side margins around the upper body
supporting_features.evidence: The lower footprint extends farther beyond the upper section on one visible side.
